differential_form: rho u_tt = Div(A : sym grad u)  (elastic wave eq., LOCALITY-001 L-003)
present_in_v11_or_core: structure accepted in LOCALITY-001 once rho > 0 and acoustic positivity hold
derivation_status: DERIVED only after the frozen inertia rho is supplied. LOCALITY-001 and INERTIA-001 both record that rho is NOT supplied by the frozen static elastic energy.
required_extras: A positive momentum density or kinetic metric; this is precisely the closure gap INERTIA-001 leaves open.

derivation_status: DERIVED but gives diffusion-like relaxation, not wavefront evolution
required_extras: Replacing the dissipative dynamics by a conservative one requires introducing a kinetic sector not present in CORE-001.

differential_form: (I - ell^2 Laplacian) u = s(rho)  (Helmholtz / MB-001 form)
present_in_v11_or_core: present in CORE-001-E09 and WL-003 / MB-001
required_extras: Time derivative is absent. This is an elliptic equation, not a wave equation. No wavefront follows without a time structure.

derivation_status: NOT DERIVED. Would require both a second-order kinetic sector and a Lorentzian signature; neither is supplied by the frozen corpus.
required_extras: Both an inertia closure (INERTIA-001) and a signature/causality closure (METRIC-001) are required. Neither is frozen.

differential_form: u_t = -beta grad u  (transport equation along a flow)
derivation_status: not admissible as a native transport law (would require an independently specified flow vector)
required_extras: Introduces a global flow field; forbidden by FP-1 / FP-4 and not supported by the V11 microscopic structure.

differential_form: alpha_resolved = 3 alpha_EM  as a wavefront law
present_in_v11_or_core: the numerical identity appears in V11 (4) but is a numerical relation, not a transport equation
required_extras: A numerical equality of two scalar amplitudes does not supply differential structure.
